name: Escape of detonation products
blurb: The escape of detonation products (Fickett and Rivard 1974; ExactPack’s ehep): a piston at 0.05 drove a detonation (gamma = 3, CJ speed 0.85, density 1.6) through 1 unit of explosive, beyond which is vacuum. The run starts from the exact solution at t = 1.2, just after the detonation reached the end: the products escape into the vacuum at up to 0.85, and a rarefaction runs back to the piston, reaching it at t = 3.16, and reflects from it. Every region of the flow is in closed form. It ends at t = 4.2 of the solution.
